text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming-prod p99 latency breach detected for SSE/WebSocket responses. p95 ~ 1.8s -> 3.0s, p99 ~ 6.7s -> 21.3s for tail requests. Several streaming sessions reporting long pauses (10-20s) between chunks. Paging oncall now.

devon: oncall here, looking. Any recent deploys to proxy or runtime?

maria: no runtime deploys in last 2h. I see a config change to proxy keepalive time at 12:12 UTC from 60s -> 5s (PR #3421) rolled 12:15. Could be related.

sam: that's the Dedicated edge proxy group (edge-proxy-us-west). Lower keepalive could cause premature connection resets + client reprobes + retransmit delays. But why are chunks pausing for >10s rather than immediate disconnects?

kai: might be an interaction with client backpressure. If clients aren't reading fast, proxy buffers fill and then we hit slow-writer behaviour in the runtime. Looking at socket metrics now.

maria: logs from proxy show many TCP zero-window events for connections where keepalive was reduced. Also see 504s from edge-proxy -> runtime in same time window.

devon: grabbing runtime tail logs for a few affected requests.

deploy-bot: deploy event: proxy-config-update deployed to edge-proxy-us-west by j.lee at 2026-03-15T12:15:22Z (change: keepalive_idle 60->5s).

devon: runtime logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T12:19:01Z [stream-handler] conn_id=abcd1234 chunk_sent=0 waiting_for_client_read
2026-03-15T12:19:12Z [kv-cache] prefix_miss
2026-03-15T12:19:22Z [stream-handler] stalled_for=10.8s backpressure=true
```

kai: stack shows stream-handler is waiting on downstream socket to accept writes. My hypothesis: proxy keepalive change caused the proxy to aggressively close idle tails, clients re-opening and not reading fast enough, resulting in oscillating write backpressure that the runtime treats as slow consumers and stalls chunk emission while retrying or queuing state.

sam: customer-impact: CS dashboard shows ~14 customers with degraded streaming sessions (15-120s visible pauses). One customer app (acme-playground) reported a replay showing a 18s pause mid-stream. Marking impact: partial degradation (not total outage), SLO p99 breached. Need to notify impacted customers.

cs-liz: pinging the affected accounts and drafting a short note. ETA for mitigation?

devon: mitigation plan in order of speed:
- 1) roll back proxy keepalive change to 60s (fastest)
- 2) temporarily enable streaming fallbacks to chunked polling for sessions detected as slow consumers
- 3) increase socket write buffer on runtime and edge-proxy
- 4) scale up runtime pool for streaming handlers (if still needed)

maria: rolling back keepalive now. Executing rollback on edge-proxy-us-west (canary first).

deploy-bot: rollback started: proxy-config-update -> revert initiated by maria at 2026-03-15T12:28:10Z.

kai: watching observability. Also enabling an automatic backpressure metric alert for slow-writer ratio crossing 2%.

devon: adding a temporary server-side throttle for long-running streams: if write backlog > 1MB for 5s, switch to chunked fallback for that session. Pushing config change to runtime (hot reload).

sam: runtime config change ready, applying to streaming-prod-canary.

devon: applied fallback rule to canary at 2026-03-15T12:36:05Z.

maria: rollback completed on canary and then staged to majority of edge-proxy-us-west by 12:40. Monitoring.

kai: metrics starting to improve: p95 dropping back to ~1.9s at 12:45, p99 trending down to 3.6s. Number of stalled sessions decreasing.

cs-liz: sent initial customer message at 12:47: "We're investigating intermittent streaming pauses; rollback in progress and mitigation applied; we'll follow up with root cause and timeline." Received a few inbound tickets.

devon: can we snapshot a sample of affected connection traces for postmortem? Need stream IDs and client user-agents.

maria: exported traces for window 12:12-12:45 UTC and uploaded to /internal/triage/6250001111/traces.tar.gz

sam: note for RCA: root cause appears to be configuration change to proxy keepalive + unexpected client read patterns (slow clients) causing backpressure amplification across proxy->runtime path. Also consider improving graceful degradation: prefer immediate chunked fallback rather than pausing full stream.

kai: follow-ups:
- add rollout guard for proxy keepalive changes (canary only for 1h, smoke check for slow-writer metric)
- add documentation for recommended keepalive defaults for streaming workloads
- evaluate making chunked-fallback enabled by default for long-tail detection

devon: leaving a handoff. I'm off at 13:15 UTC. Handoff to sam for next steps and postmortem lead.

sam: acknowledged, taking handoff. I'll draft postmortem and schedule RCA session. Oncall rotation: @oncall-night (sam) will watch thresholds overnight; alert policy extended to lower threshold for p99.

cs-liz: I'll keep customers updated and post an incident summary once we have RCA.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (partial) — rollbacks + fallback applied. Severity: Sev2. Incident opened 6250001111, mitigated 6250004500, assigned sam for follow-up.

maria: quick note — we should also look at websocket fragmentation settings; some clients use small MTU and cause many small writes which worsen backpressure.

devon: agreed. Adding that to the action items list.

sam: logging action items and owners. I'll create the postmortem doc and schedule the RCA.

devon: leaving channel. Good handoff.

cs-liz: closing customer loop for now; will reopen if any further reports.

incident-bot: Thread archived at 2026-03-15T13:45:00Z."
